title: I tried to take pics again, but this time I was was caught
content: It happened again. I was back. I have the thought of, “oh fuck I’m back here.” I see stairs, elevators, rows of stores/hotel rooms and I want to cry. I think to myself, “This time I’m getting pics,” and I’m determined. I get out my phone and as I try to snap a pic of this staircase, but a crowd gets in the way, then cheerleaders are tossed in the air to block the shot, then more throngs of people pushing through. I snap on regardless. I have to show you all. Suddenly, I’m in the back seat of an suv and my mom is there with me. They threaten to drive us off a cliff…men in suits. I open my phone, and frantically promise to delete the pics, I give them my phone and tell them to delete the pics, just please don’t kill us. We end up at an amusement park/carnival outside. We are being watched and I don’t have my phone. They have kids there who are actually “security” watching people, but my mom and I escape them finally by making a break through one of these amusement park restaurants. These 3 kids chase us, but we know these kids are easy to escape. I calm down some, but am still nervous. I know the men in suits aren’t coming anymore, but her and I do make it out the final door and then I woke up. Been feeling stressed all day over it. I tried to show you all and now I’m scared. 😔
